item.title: Building OCR2MD: From a Simple OCR Script to a Production-Ready OCR-to-Markdown Platform
item.description:
Building OCR2MD: A Complete OCR-to-Markdown Platform

Modern organizations deal with thousands of scanned documents every year. Reports, invoices, audit records, government files, historical archives, handwritten forms, meeting notes, and books often exist only as scanned PDFs or images.

Extracting this information into a structured format is surprisingly difficult.

Most OCR tools only recover plain text. Tables lose their structure, headings become paragraphs, images disappear, and manually cleaning the results consumes far more time than the OCR itself.

item.title: How to Fix Firefox Saving PDFs Instead of Printing in Google Sheets
item.description:
If you frequently use Google Sheets inside Mozilla Firefox, you may have run into a frustrating issue: when you hit the “Print” button, Firefox downloads or prompts you to save a PDF file instead of sending the document straight to your physical printer.

While this feels like a glitch, it is actually expected behavior based on how Google Sheets interacts with different browsers. Fortunately, there are several straightforward ways to fix this workflow.

item.title: The Definitive Guide to Signing PDFs on Every Device
item.description:
Handling physical paperwork is rapidly becoming a relic of the past. Whether you are finalizing a business contract, approving an invoice, or filling out administrative forms, knowing how to add a clean, secure signature to a PDF directly from your device saves time and eliminates unnecessary printing.

Here is a comprehensive breakdown of how to sign a PDF document using your preferred operating system or browser without needing expensive enterprise software.
